title: Microsoft Teams: shared display mode and BYOD peripheral detection in GCC High and DoD
summary: The briefing's availability, licensing and data-collection controls are supported by the roadmap and Microsoft documentation. It correctly distinguishes the government-cloud collection default from portal ingestion and reports the conflicting DoD documentation. Minor source discrepancies remain in the module-version wording and role-assignment button label.
